v.s: Check a product title or model against CPSC recalls\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>

Runs the rules a shop's sales get on the text you send. Our code doesn't store or log it. It travels in the page address, so the web host's request logs may include it. At least one of title and model is needed. Limited to 60 checks an hour per visitor.
Read one CPSC recall by its number\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The same public record get_recall returns. No key, no cookie, and no shop or buyer data. Shares /api/check's limit of 60 checks an hour per visitor. Responses use no-store and allow any origin.
Not offered. Every answer comes back on its own POST.\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The server is stateless and opens no event stream, so a GET is refused with 405.
The same check as an MCP tool over Streamable HTTP\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

Two read-only tools: check_recall(title, model), and get_recall(recallNumber), which gives one recall's CPSC text. Stateless: each request stands alone. Send JSON-RPC 2.0, with Accept application/json, text/event-stream. It shares the limit of /api/check.

The newest day of recalls in the latest Recall Replay, against the demo shop\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Read from the latest stored Recall Replay run, so it costs no new check. Only the demo shop is public.
One Recall Replay run with all its rows\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
The rows /replay/{runId} shows. CPSC's public text and the demo shop's item titles, nothing about a buyer.
Recount a Recall Replay's headline numbers from its own rows\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Works the counts out again from the run's stored rows and compares them with the numbers it reported.
Whether the site is working, check by check\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Each check and the reading behind it. Never includes a secret or a database error's text.
